decisions.reason: Changing how board orders are added to the client's JLCPCB account does not alter the required BOM contents or part-number accuracy.
The account-invitation configuration method does not change the requirement to verify component orientations in JLCPCB.
The order configuration method has no effect on connector pin markings or their board location.
Adding orders through the client's account does not cancel or modify the required PCB production export files.
The selected account workflow does not alter component availability, compatible-alternative, or sourcing requirements.
The JLCPCB account workflow does not change any interboard power connector, pinout, or topology requirement.
The method used to configure the manufacturing order does not change the sensor board's component-fit requirement.
The order configuration method does not alter the charge-status LED circuit or population requirements.
The JLCPCB account invitation does not change ESP32 pin coverage or through-hole breakout requirements.
The manufacturing-order workflow does not affect the panel GPIO controls, connectors, or assigned pins.
The account-based order configuration method does not change the panel reset connector or electrical behavior.
The method for adding board orders to JLCPCB does not alter DCDC1 voltage regulation or its compensation purpose.
